name: slave
description: SLAVE — Self-operating Logic & Autonomous Virtual Executor

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cp -n .env.example server/.env || true
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
